mainEntity.name: Is it safe to get adjusted if I have a herniated disc?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the disc injury, symptoms, and exam findings. Dr. Abe evaluates whether an adjustment, decompression, another conservative option, or medical referral is appropriate before treatment.

mainEntity.name: Should I rest or stay active with back pain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some rest helps early on, but too much of it can slow recovery. We'll give you a specific plan for what to do and avoid based on what's actually causing your pain.

mainEntity.name: What if my back pain radiates down my leg?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pain traveling into the leg can involve an irritated nerve, including sciatica, but an exam is needed to assess the cause. Seek urgent care for progressive weakness or bladder or bowel changes.

mainEntity.name: How many visits does back pain usually take to improve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mechanical strain often improves within a few visits; disc-related pain can take longer. We reassess along the way and adjust the plan as you go.
